summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package ships a `preinstall` hook (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a ~727KB obfuscator.io-transformed single-line bundle shipped in the tarball (shuffled string-array rotor, hex-mangled identifiers, numeric/character decoder table). The Bun-runtime execution path routes payload code through a non-Node interpreter at `npm install`, evading Node-based install-time scanners. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with the same identifier-mangling style (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, wrapper-object dispatch such as `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync,...)`), hiding the download/chmod/execute chain. The advertised purpose is a Docusaurus UI-kit contribution, which has no need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated install-time payload. Both mechanisms — alternate-runtime dropper and lifecycle-script obfuscation — fire automatically on default `npm install`, executing attacker-authored obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
